item.text: The current write paths all serialize metadata into `Fields`, and the read paths decode only that string. I also found an existing locked, paged migration pattern in this package. I’m adding a small failing test for the new map format before changing the write and read paths.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'

## Investigation

Root cause: all three write paths set "'`event.Fields` to serialized JSON and `dynamodbattribute.MarshalMap` stores it as a DynamoDB string. Session and search reads deserialize only `Fields`. Existing RFD24 migration demonstrates a strongly consistent paged scan, bounded batches, retries of unprocessed writes, and `backend.RunWhileLocked`.

Hypothesis: storing a native map on writes, reconstructing JSON from it on reads (with legacy fallback), and idempotently migrating legacy records under a distributed lock will preserve behavior and expose fields to DynamoDB expressions. Numeric JSON tokens require explicit conversion to DynamoDB N and back to avoid precision loss.
EOF'

Updated DynamoDB audit events to store metadata in the native `FieldsMap` attribute. Reads still support legacy `Fields` records while a distributed-locked, resumable batch migration converts them and validates their content. Added `backend.FlagKey` for the migration flag and kept pagination checkpoints stable during conversion.
